title: Blood Moon: Night Hunt
description: Automatic Blood Moon nights, stronger mobs, new cursed enemies, weapons, charms, and rare loot for Minecraft Fabric.
body:
# Blood Moon: Night Hunt

**Blood Moon: Night Hunt** is a Fabric mod that makes Minecraft nights more dangerous, intense, and rewarding.

Every few in-game days, a Blood Moon rises. During this cursed night, hostile mobs become stronger, special enemies appear near players, and rare Blood Moon materials can be collected.

The event happens automatically. No commands are needed.

## Features

### Automatic Blood Moon Event

Blood Moons start naturally after several in-game days. When the event begins, the night becomes much more dangerous.

During a Blood Moon:

* hostile mobs become stronger;
* enemies gain extra effects;
* special Blood Moon mobs can spawn;
* rare cursed materials become obtainable;
* survival becomes more intense.

## New Mobs

### Blood Zombie

A cursed version of the undead. It is stronger than a normal zombie and can be much more dangerous during a Blood Moon.

Drops may include:

* Blood Shards;
* Cursed Bones;
* rare Blood Moon loot.

### Lunar Stalker

A fast and aggressive creature that hunts players during Blood Moon nights.

Drops may include:

* Lunar Fangs;
* Stalker Claws;
* cursed materials.

## New Items

### Blood Shard

A cursed material used for crafting Blood Moon equipment.

### Lunar Fang

A rare drop from Lunar Stalkers, used for crafting fast weapons.

### Cursed Bone

A dark bone filled with Blood Moon energy.

### Stalker Claw

A sharp claw used in special Blood Moon recipes.

### Hunter Blade

A weapon made for fighting during Blood Moon nights.

### Lunar Dagger

A fast weapon for players who prefer speed.

### Night Charm

A protective charm that can sometimes delay a Blood Moon and give the player more time to prepare.

### Blood Apple

A special food item made with Blood Moon materials.

### Blood Totem

A combat item that becomes useful during Blood Moon events.

## Why use this mod?

Blood Moon: Night Hunt keeps the vanilla survival feeling, but makes nights more meaningful. You will need to prepare your base, craft better gear, and be ready when the moon turns red.

This mod does not add huge magic systems or new dimensions. It focuses on one clear idea: making the night dangerous again.

## Credits

Created by Zadko.
